question: Does the unchanged model-generated project execute through the unchanged server wrapper with actual spec/input/output paths?
configurations: Canonical network-execution-v1 spec under the same fixed 1001-byte question
criteria: Both isolated executions return zero; network-observations-v1 contains exactly one recorded received_bytes observation of 1001 bytes, matching the independently calculated deterministic payload digest and EOF/exact-content checks. Sum of receive chunk sizes is 1001 and every nonempty read is at most 37 bytes; do not require a fixed number of recv calls.
controls: Original project files and wrapper bytes preserved and hashed. No model-written code runs on the controller host. Offline Linux Docker, read-only root and inputs, one CPU, 512 MiB, 64 PIDs, at most 45 seconds per configuration; no dependency installation needed for empty locks.
replication_unit: Two software interface configurations, not independent scientific replications. No confidence interval or population inference.
missing_failure: Retain original stdout/stderr and failed output without correction. Missing output is missing, not zero.
limits: Uses local Linux ARM image versus model development on Linux x86. This tests Python/socket interface compatibility; no fresh EC2 or authenticated user request is implied.
